phase: ROADMAP Stage 6 (first item): local configuration + offline model option skeleton v1 (offline / prompt_only / openai_compatible modes; offline is default and makes no network call)
summary: Added a deterministic, stdlib-only Stage 6 local-config + offline-model skeleton. build_local_config returns a safe default (model_mode=offline, allow_network=false) and normalizes an optional override; provider configuration is surfaced only as a boolean derived via bool(os.getenv(...)), never reading credential values or .env. validate_local_config checks the mode and preference types and warns when openai_compatible is chosen without a configured provider. call_llm is now mode-aware: offline returns a local placeholder draft, prompt_only returns the strict prompt, and only openai_compatible may reach the network (degrading to prompt_only when unconfigured); offline/prompt_only hard-guarantee network_used=false. New HTTP endpoints GET /api/config and POST /api/config/validate, and /api/generate now threads payload.config into call_llm. A front-end 设置 panel exposes the model-mode selector and offline boundary. No dependency install, no local inference engine, no network/model call, no secret/.env read.
implemented: backend/server.py: added MODEL_MODES, OFFLINE_MODEL_MODES, build_local_config(overrides=None) (method=local_config_v1, default offline, provider_configured as bool only), validate_local_config(config), build_offline_placeholder_draft(prompt).

backend/server.py: call_llm(prompt, config=None) is now mode-aware; offline/prompt_only make no network call and return network_used=false; openai_compatible keeps the existing remote path and returns network_used=true (or degrades to prompt_only when unconfigured).
backend/server.py: Handler.do_GET serves GET /api/config (build_local_config); do_POST serves POST /api/config/validate (422 on invalid) and passes payload.config into call_llm for /api/generate.
frontend/index.html: added a 设置 nav button and #settings panel with #modelMode selector, #applyConfigBtn, offline boundary text, #configStatus and #configLog.

frontend/app.js: added state.config, loadConfig()/renderConfigStatus()/applyConfig() wired to /api/config and /api/config/validate, persists mws_model_mode in localStorage, and threads {config:{model_mode}} into /api/generate.

tests/test_local_config.py: 18 tests (config defaults, validation, offline no-network guarantee incl. a urlopen monkeypatch, live HTTP GET/POST config + offline generate, and frontend settings-panel assertions).
tools/run_quality_gates.py: py-compile gate now includes tests/test_local_config.py.
README.md and docs/ROADMAP.md document the v1 boundary; only the ROADMAP '本地配置页面和完全离线模型选项' item is marked done (other Stage 6 items untouched).
not_implemented: No bundled or real local inference engine; offline mode returns a deterministic placeholder draft plus the strict prompt.
No dependency install, no container/packaging work.
No multi-user roles, encryption/backup, provider data-flow risk grading, or dependency locking (other Stage 6 items remain unchecked).
No network/model call in offline or prompt_only modes; no credential or .env read in any mode.
test_status: python -m unittest tests.test_local_config -v: 18 tests OK (includes live ThreadingHTTPServer GET/POST and a urlopen monkeypatch proving offline makes no network call).
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v: 339 tests OK.
python tools/run_quality_gates.py --json (default 'python' on PATH): passed=true, all 5 gates passed; unittest gate ran 339 tests OK.
risks: call_llm gained an optional config arg; existing callers that omit it now get offline behavior (no network) rather than the old auto-remote-if-configured behavior. The HTTP /api/generate path passes payload.config, defaulting to offline when absent — a deliberate safe default, but a behavior change for any caller that relied on implicit remote calls.
Offline placeholder draft is a fixed template plus the prompt; it is not model output and must not be mistaken for a generated draft.
provider_configured only reflects presence of MATERIAL_LLM_BASE_URL and MATERIAL_LLM_API_KEY via bool(); it does not validate that the endpoint actually works.
The settings panel persists the chosen mode in browser localStorage only; there is no server-side or multi-user persistence (out of scope for v1).

Environment note: the local interpreter is python3 (no bare 'python' on PATH); the quality-gate runner honors PYTHON=python3, and a local 'python->python3' PATH shim lets its default-interpreter meta-test pass.
credentials: No credentials or .env files were read, created, or modified; provider settings are surfaced only as booleans via bool(os.getenv(...)).
No external network calls were used for implementation or local tests; offline/prompt_only modes are proven to make no network call.
No push performed; commit/push left to the maintainer.
